company_name: SuZhou Dongmai New Material Technology CO.,Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — Suzhou Dongmai New Material Technology specializes in high-purity engineering plastics critical for semiconductor manufacturing and packaging.
summary: Suzhou Dongmai New Material Technology Co., Ltd. produces advanced engineering plastic materials, specifically polyimide (PI) and polyphenylene sulfide (PPS), which are essential for semiconductor manufacturing and packaging. Their products offer high-temperature resistance, chemical stability, and mechanical strength, catering to various industries including electronics and aerospace.
capabilities: High-purity polyimide (PI) materials for semiconductor applications
Polyphenylene sulfide (PPS) with high thermal resistance and mechanical strength
Custom engineering plastic components and profiles
Integrated solutions for R&D and production of engineering plastic parts

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Suzhou, China, and collaborates with suppliers in Europe and Japan.
